name: dataset/apps.py
summary: Django AppConfig class that registers and configures the dataset application within the Django project.
purpose: Serves as the configuration entry point for the dataset Django app, enabling the framework to discover, register, and initialize the application during the project startup sequence.
responsibilities: Register the dataset app with Django's app registry
Define application metadata and default configuration
Provide a startup initialization hook via the ready() method
Encapsulate app-level configuration within the dataset boundary
outputs: Configured dataset app instance in Django's app registry
architecture_notes: Implements Django's standard AppConfig pattern to declare the dataset app as a self-contained module. This class acts as the boundary definition for the dataset domain, separating its configuration from other backend applications. If the ready() method is overridden, it becomes the canonical location for lazy imports, signal wiring, and initialization logic to avoid side effects during module import time.
improvements: Explicitly declare name and default_auto_field attributes to prevent implicit configuration warnings
Override ready() to register dataset-specific signals or perform startup validation
Add docstrings explaining the app's role in the broader architecture
Consider adding a verbose_name for administrative clarity
